title: Circuit Trace Board — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Source pulse and trunk
scenes.purpose: The idea starts as a pulse at pad P0 and travels the trunk trace to junction J1.
visuals: Green solder-mask board with via grid
P0 pad lights with an expanding ring
Bright pulse and lit copper fill the P0→J1 centreline

beats.development: P0 IDEA pad lights; ring pulse marks the source.
captions: AN IDEA BECOMES A CONNECTED SYSTEM
REV 1.0 · SIGNAL PATH: IDEA → J1 → U1 · U2 · U3

beats.development: Pulse travels the trunk at constant speed and sinks into J1.

scenes.title: Branch at J1
scenes.purpose: J1 lights and three pulses branch; each destination pad lights at its arrival, ordered by trace length.
visuals: Three pulses on the U1, U2 and U3 routes
U1 lights at 1.64 s, U2 at 1.95 s, U3 at 2.08 s

beats.development: J1 lights; pulses split; the shortest route reaches ① U1 PEOPLE.
The jogged route reaches ② U2 TOOLS.
The longest route reaches ③ U3 FLOW.

scenes.title: Connected system hold
scenes.purpose: All pads glow steadily; the whole board is settled and readable.
visuals: All traces lit, all pads glowing

beats.development: Rings settle; the connected system holds for reading.
captions: PADS LIGHT IN ORDER OF ARRIVAL · BRANCH DELAY = TRACE LENGTH

findings: Constant-speed travel makes each arrival time follow trace length; arrivals are spaced 0.31 s and 0.13 s apart, brisk but readable.
justifiedHolds: 2.44–3.00 s settled hold so the full board and labels can be read.

notes: No preview recipe is listed in STYLE.json; the core characteristic action is shown.
